name: craft
description: AI code review and code-quality skills for coding agents.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: AI code review for Claude Code: a diff review in any language with verified findings and one verdict before the pull request, a whole-crate Rust audit and a fix plan from review findings — plus the code-quality skills the review judges by: a broad Rust set (ownership, concurrency, traits, performance, unsafe, errors, idioms, ecosystem, architecture, web, CLI, security, plugins, macros, fintech, cloud-native), Nix, and language-agnostic engineering skills (specs, debugging, refactoring, onboarding). Self-contained, no plugin dependencies.
